targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM click_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM click_events WHERE outcome = 'hit' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM click_events WHERE outcome = 'miss' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
SELECT count(DISTINCT client_ip) AS value FROM click_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '$__interval') AS time, outcome AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM click_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, outcome ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top links (hits)
panels.description: Per link in the time range: hits, where it is used, and where it forwarded to at click time. Grouped by the link itself, so renaming a link does not split its history.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(r.label, r.path, ce.path) AS "title", CASE WHEN r.path IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'https://' || r.display_host || '/' || r.path END AS "link", count(*) AS hits, r.description AS "used on", coalesce((array_remove(array_agg(ce.redirect_url ORDER BY ce.ts DESC), NULL))[1], min(r.redirect_url)) AS "forwarded to" FROM click_events ce LEFT JOIN redirects r ON r.path_hash = encode(sha256(convert_to(ce.path, 'UTF8')), 'hex') WHERE ce.outcome = 'hit' AND $__timeFilter(ce.ts) GROUP BY r.path_hash, 1, 2, 4 ORDER BY hits DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: All links (registry)
panels.description: Every registered link, ignoring the time range. title = the link's name (redirects.label); link = the full URL as handed out (display_host + path — every link also works on the other domain); forwards to = the current destination, shown as '→ <title>' when it points at another of your own links. Hashes are only used internally to join, never shown.

targets.rawSql: WITH h AS (SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(path, 'UTF8')), 'hex') AS ph, count(*) AS n, max(ts) AS last_hit FROM click_events WHERE outcome = 'hit' GROUP BY 1) SELECT coalesce(r.label, r.path, '(untitled)') AS "title", coalesce(CASE WHEN r.path IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'https://' || r.display_host || '/' || r.path END, '(path not recorded)') AS "link", r.description AS "used on", CASE WHEN t.path_hash IS NOT NULL THEN '→ ' || coalesce(t.label, t.path, 'one of your links') WHEN r.redirect_url IS NULL OR r.redirect_url = '' THEN '(parked: no destination yet)' ELSE r.redirect_url END AS "forwards to", coalesce(h.n, 0) AS "hits (all time)", h.last_hit AS "last hit" FROM redirects r LEFT JOIN h ON h.ph = r.path_hash LEFT JOIN redirects t ON r.redirect_url ~ '^https?://(goto|qr)\.conrad-klaus\.de/' AND t.path_hash = encode(sha256(convert_to(regexp_replace(r.redirect_url, '^https?://(goto|qr)\.conrad-klaus\.de/', ''), 'UTF8')), 'hex') ORDER BY coalesce(h.n, 0) DESC, 1

panels.title: Possible enumeration (misses by IP)
panels.description: Failed lookups per client in the time range, with the paths they tried.

targets.rawSql: SELECT client_ip, country, count(*) AS misses, left(string_agg(DISTINCT path, '  ·  '), 300) AS "tried" FROM click_events WHERE outcome = 'miss' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY misses DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Recent activity
panels.description: Every resolve attempt: what the visitor typed, the matching link's title and where it is used (empty on a miss), and where it forwarded to at click time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ce.ts AS "time", ce.outcome, ce.path AS "typed", r.label AS "title", r.description AS "used on", ce.redirect_url AS "forwarded to", ce.client_ip, ce.country, ce.user_agent FROM click_events ce LEFT JOIN redirects r ON r.path_hash = encode(sha256(convert_to(ce.path, 'UTF8')), 'hex') WHERE $__timeFilter(ce.ts) ORDER BY ce.ts DESC LIMIT 100
